observations.beforeActionResult: Different weapon/back-unit categories and descriptions are browsed; selection previews show part-specific parameters. Do not use the long holds simply as footage-duration filler.

Selection moves among MELANDER, TIAN-QIANG, VP-44S and NACHTREIHER head candidates; displayed AP, stability, weight and right-side total preview change. No purchase/application of these heads is demonstrated.
Selected body/arm/leg components and their prospective unit changes are visible. Different body categories are alternatives, not a controlled one-variable combat test.
BST-G2/P04 preview shows improvements and costs against current booster.
FCS-G2/P10SLT preview shows increased close/medium/long-range assist along with greater weight and EN Load. This FCS is previewed, not shown installed.
Rapid category changes demonstrate distinct configuration dimensions; use short contextual clips rather than an unsupported power-ranking montage.
Toggle Display reveals detailed prospective booster/unit stats in two panels; values provide direct visible comparison, not measured motion.
BST-G2/P04 purchase confirmed; COAM decreases from207644 to135644, matching72000 listed cost. Purchased inventory is distinct from installed equipment.

Existing BST-G1/P10 selected, new BST-G2/P04 previewed, selection briefly returns to old booster, then new booster is installed at approximately238.5–239s with EQ marking the new tile and Boost Speed320 retained.
SI-24:SU-Q5 shield is selected and purchased, then appears on L-BACK Unit and visibly changes the mecha model. This is not a shield-effectiveness combat test.
Training lesson is selected after garage return. AC TEST is a distinct mode; this excerpt does not show entering AC TEST or a before/after field test.

fcsAt137.meaning: Assist figures increase while weight and standing energy requirement also increase; none of these is an observed DPS measurement.

boosterExpandedAt156.meaning: Higher movement figures coexist with higher energy demand/weight and lower energy-supply efficiency. A heavier booster can still improve resulting boost speed; do not claim weight alone always determines speed.

boosterInstalledAt239.limit: Installed menu values, not a timed world-speed experiment.

criticalMisleadingTransitionToAvoid.actualObserved: 1360s selects TRAINING, not AC TEST. Training mecha AP10550 differs from earlier player-configuration AP9080.
criticalMisleadingTransitionToAvoid.decision: Never connect this as proof that the just-customized loadout was tested or that a specific component caused improved combat performance. Training footage may only illustrate its correctly named independent training role if root actually needs it.
